summary_of_theorems.T1_basis_coordinate_decomposition: d = u B^{-1} = (d_piv, d_free) with d_{free,j} = u_{F_j} and d_{piv,i} = (u_{P_i} + sum_j C_{i,j} u_{F_j}) / q in Z.
summary_of_theorems.T2_nonzero_free_support_invariant: Every nonzero u in (-q/2, q/2)^n cap ker(H mod q) satisfies s_F = supp_F(u) >= 1.
summary_of_theorems.T3_modulus_independent_bounds: For u in [-U, U]^n cap ker(H mod q) with U < q/2, |d_{piv,i}| <= floor(U * s_F / 2) independently of q. The fixed-q ternary maximum is floor((1+s_F*(q-1)/2)/q). The q-independent envelope is 0 (s_F=1), 1 (s_F=2), and floor((s_F-1)/2) (s_F>=3); it is not necessarily sharp at a specified q.
summary_of_theorems.T4_colinear_separation_and_deterministic: For ternary u in {-1,0,1}^n \ {0}, deterministic (p_split=nextprime(W), g_res=1) eliminates colinear multiple collisions |k| >= 2 inside width-W cubes, hits a free coordinate d_{j_pivot} = 1 within at most n - m trials j_pivot in {m, ..., n-1}, and yields delta_{j_pivot} = (1 - 1)/p_split = 0 so ||delta||_1 = ||d||_1 - 1.
